paite: Kongkhak ngak pawl khendan: Kore mi bel Asaph tapate lak a Kore tapa Meshelemiah ahi.
heading: Tempul Vengtute
english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

paite: Huan Meshelemiah in tapate anei a: ata masa Zekariah ahi a, azom Jediael, athumna Zebadiah, alina Jathniel;
english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

paite: angana Elam, agukna Jehohanan, asagihna Elioenai ahi.
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

paite: Obed-edom in tapate anei a; ata masa Shemaiah ahi a, azom Jehozabad, athumna Joah, alina Sakar, angana Nethaneel,
english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

paite: agukna Amiel, asagihna Issakar, agiatna Peulethai ahi, amah bel Pathian in avualzawl hi.
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

paite: Atapa Shemaiah a kipan tapa, a-inkote uh vaihawmte leng apiang ua; amaute mihat hangsan ahi chiat uhi.
english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

paite: Shemaiah tapate Othni, Rephael, Obed leh Elzabadte ahi ua, a-unau uh Elihu leh Semakiah bel mihat mahmah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

paite: Huaite tengteng Obed-edom suante ahi ua: amau leh atapate uh leh a-unaute uh nasepna lamsang ah mi piching ahi uh; Obed-edom a kipan mite sawmguk-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

paite: Meshelemiah in tapa leh unau mihat mahmah sawm-le-giat anei hi.
english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

paite: Merari suante lak a Hosah in leng tapate anei a; Shimri bel amakai lianpen ahi a, ta masa ahi kei na a, apa'n makaipen in abawl hi.
english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

paite: Azom in Hilkiah ahi a, athumna Tebaliah, alina Zekariah ahi. Hosah tapate leh a-unaute avek un sawm-le-thum ahi uh.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

paite: Huai amakaipente lak a mi a-unaute uh bang a TOUPA' inn a nasem thilbawl a tantuan nei a kongkhak ngakmi pawl a akhente uh ahi.
english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Aneu alian in, a-inkuan dungzui zel un kongpi chih a om ding zonna ding in ai asan uhi.
english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

paite: Huchi in suahlam a dia aisan pen Shelemiah tung ah atu hi. Lemgel siam piltak, atapa Zekariah a ding in ai asan ua, mallam pen amah a tuam in atu hi.
english: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

paite: Simlam bel Obed-edom tuam in; atapate tuam in Asuppim.
english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

paite: Tumlam a toupaina lampi a Shaleketh kongkhak venna toh, Shuppim leh Hosah tuam in.
english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

paite: Suahlam ah Levite guk a-om ua, niteng in mallam ah li, simlam ah li, thil koihkhawmna inn ah nih tuaktuak.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

paite: Tumlam inn um sung a ding in alutna ah li; inn um sung ah nih.
english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

paite: Huaite ahi uh, Korah tapate leh Merari mi tapate kongkhak ngakmi pawl akhente uh.
english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

paite: Huan a-unaute uh Levite lak ah Ahijah, Pathian sum koihkhawmna inn leh thil latsate koihkhawmna inn heutu ahi.
heading: Sumkemte Leh Ulian Dangte
english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

paite: Laadan tapate: Gershon mite tapate Laadante a te, pipute inkote amakai lianpen Gershon mi Laadan a te; Jehieli.
english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

paite: Jehieli tapate: Zetham, Joel a-unaupa, TOUPA' inn a sum koihkhawmna heutu ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Amram mite a kipan, Izhar mite a kipan, Hebron mite a kipan, Uzziel mite a kipan:
english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

paite: Mosi tapa, Gershom tapa Shebuel sum koihkhawmna heutu ahi.
english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

paite: A-unaute bel Eliezer tapa Rahabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zikri leh Shelomithte ahi.
english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

paite: Shelomith leh a-unaute bel kumpipa David leh a-inkote uh makaipen sepaih sangkhat heutute leh zakhat heutute leh sepaih pawl heutute'n ahihsiangthousa uh, thil siangthou koihkhawmna inn tengteng kemte ahi uhi.
english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

paite: Kidouna gallak thilte TOUPA' inn bawlphatna ding in akoih uhi.
english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh’s house.

paite: Zawlnei Samuel, Kish tapa Saul, Ner tapa Abner leh Zeruiah tapa Joabte'n ahihsiangthou tengteng uh, kuapeuh in thil ahihsiangthousa peuhmah uh Shelomith leh a-unaute kep vek ahi.
english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

paite: Izhar mi Kenaniah leh atapate Israel gam polam tungtang thu a heutute leh vaihawmmi ahi uh.
heading: Levi Dangte Nasep
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

paite: Hebron mi Hashabiah leh a-unau mihangsan sangkhat-le-zasagih Jordan gal tumlam a Israelte ukpate ahi uhi; TOUPA nna tengteng leh kumpipa nasepna lam nna ah.
english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh and for the service of the king.

paite: Hebron mi Jerijah bel asuan uh tungtang thu a inko makai lam ah Hebronte, amakaipente ahi uhi. David kum sawmli avaihawm kum a azon un Gilead gam a Jazer ah mihat hangsan amukhia uhi.
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

paite: A-unau mihangsante sangnih-le-zasagih ahi uhi. Huaite inko makaipen, kumpipa David in Pathian lam thil chiteng leh kumpipa na lam thu a Reuben, Gad leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte heutu dia abawlte ahi uh.
english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
